behaviors.assignee-options: Opening the Assignee filter shows Anyone, each person, and Unassigned with task counts.
behaviors.search-assignees: Typing in Find a person narrows the assignee choices.
behaviors.filter-by-person: Selecting Priya Shah shows only her two tasks and updates the task summary.
behaviors.filter-unassigned: Selecting Unassigned shows only the unassigned task.
behaviors.empty-assignee-state: Selecting Ana Lima shows “Nothing assigned to Ana Lima yet” with a Clear filters button.
behaviors.clear-filters: Clear filters resets both Status and Assignee and restores all four tasks.

history.notes: The selectors scope assignee choices to the toolbar so task-card owner names do not collide. This assumes the dropdown renders its search and choices within the toolbar.

The dropdown popup is rendered outside the toolbar, so its options and search input are located from the page. Task checks stay scoped to the board, and the final step verifies both filter controls and all four restored cards.
